# Targeted native receiving completion

Current work adds a receiving-only native wallet, separate from Counterpart and Pollar. See [service boundary](../../services/zcash-receiving/README.md).

**REAL preflight:** [native-preflight.json](live/native-preflight.json) is an authenticated response from the durable Railway wallet, generated by `zaw`/librustzcash. Its Unified address is wallet-controlled, not user-entered. It is unpaid and contains no receipt evidence. The wallet is synced to public Zcash Testnet, supports NU7 and runs locked. `/status` rejects unauthenticated access and `/api/owner/login` is not forwarded even with the backend credential.

**TESTED WITH MOCKS:** [fixture-browser](fixture-browser/results.json) uses ephemeral application records and mocked sponsor transport, including synthetic confirmation screenshots. It proves browser/API/state handling, not live settlement. Focused tests: 115 passed. Full suite: 1,637 passed, 47 skipped. Production build, typecheck and lint passed. Desktop/mobile browser regressions passed at 1440, 820, 390, 320 pixels.

The service's first native starts were SIGKILLed by the Railway 1 GiB ceiling. A pinned source build now limits seed-at-rest scrypt memory to 256 MiB, using a 384-bit random secret. This does not change wallet generation, receiving trial decryption, signing, scanning or consensus code. No signer is unlocked or exposed.

The original synthetic TypeScript sender remains unused. Public chain data, faucet API success and wallet balance alone cannot settle an invoice. Only the invoice-bound receiving wallet's decrypted exact-value note and confirmations can do so. Live application/funding acceptance will be recorded separately; this preflight is not claimed as an end-to-end payment.

## REAL end-to-end receiving completed

Gemini understood a Pidgin request and called `create_private_zec_invoice`. Counterpart created **Orchard shielded receiving demo** for exactly **0.1 Testnet ZEC**, with a fresh wallet-controlled Unified receiver and ZIP321 QR. The invoice and reminder began unpaid / awaiting approval. It did not activate a reminder, approve spending or send money.

A public proof-of-work faucet submitted transaction:

`f6dfa6acf602b2f6b936123c0abc8fa4a8b8c99359e1180f7e675f5dd154d082`

The actual receiving wallet independently decrypted a **10,000,000-zatoshi**, non-change output at that unique address, mined at **4,618,878**. Under current NU7 it is in **Ironwood pool 4**, reached through the Orchard-only Unified receiver. At **3 confirmations** / chain tip 4,618,880, the background watcher automatically persisted the confirmed request, settled invoice and completed reminder at **2026-11-14 09:04:09 UTC**. No manual verification POST was used to produce this transition. The source of hidden-value evidence is the receiving wallet, not faucet output or public metadata.

The initial 0.125 ZEC trial used a different faucet. It returned 202 then definitively rejected the Orchard receiver with “the wallet cannot pay this address” (its source maps RPC -5/-8 to that message), with 0 successful broadcasts. That invoice remains explicitly unpaid; it is not confused with this successful 0.1 ZEC receipt. Other faucet hosts failed to connect from the cloud. No founder's Windows wallet or historical feature-branch transaction was used as live proof.

The two pre-existing Ada reminders retain their original states and versions. Repeated post-settlement receipt checks do not duplicate audit events. Wallet identity and allocations survive service restart. Signing/owner API routes remain unavailable. Real wallet-derived balances are displayed; a wallet's spendable policy may require more confirmations than invoice acceptance, so pending balance is not fabricated spendable money.

The final browser monitor passed after correcting its preservation assertion to exclude the very reminder expected to become completed. Earlier browser navigation automation was adjusted for the existing obligation-count badge; no layout redesign was made. Financial state was checked independently through authenticated APIs and the native wallet.

A small release fix makes confirmed receipts show “Payment observed in receiving wallet” rather than the old “Awaiting payment evidence” timeline. It also removes the unpaid-request helper from a verified receipt. The approved Counterpart composition is unchanged.

[Outgoing signer investigation](OUTGOING-ASSESSMENT.md) is a source/security assessment only. No outgoing ZEC signing was authorized or exposed. Mainnet execution and the synthetic sender remain disabled.

Post-deployment browser acceptance on application commit `4a5a8f52bedbea2a930452fbaa18c6b0349770d6` passed: corrected receipt status, full desktop/mobile receipt captures, saved Gemini conversation including its invoice action, original responsibilities unchanged and a genuine native wallet balance of 0.1 ZEC spendable / 0 pending. Both native wallet and app had restarted; the same wallet ID, note and settled invoice persisted. The receiving wallet observed 37 confirmations during this final capture; the immutable settlement evidence correctly retains the 3 confirmations first accepted at 09:04:09 UTC.

Public proof-of-work faucet client inspected at `anukulpandey/zcash-faucet` commit `22f43840bd88ba310f68bb929e5c94e10c5abb89`. Funding used Argon2id proof-of-work, not a GitHub credential or local wallet. The faucet's initial 202 / claim ID was preserved; receipt recognition depended solely on the receiving wallet. Provider submission outcome was queried without resubmission. No private keys, viewing keys, RPC credentials or private memos are in this evidence.
